question: May runtime/gateway JSON message and media reason fields become locale-dependent, or should those protocol-facing strings remain stable while only chat/display copy is localized?
rationale: The PR localizes gateway error/message reason fields while leaving stable code/type fields, but repository policy treats protocol-facing surfaces as compatibility-sensitive and automation cannot decide whether clients may depend on those strings.

options.title: Keep Protocol Text Stable
options.body: Preserve stable gateway JSON message/reason strings and localize only clearly user-display chat/runtime copy unless a separate display field exists.

options.title: Accept Localized Gateway Messages
options.body: Allow locale-dependent gateway message/reason text because stable code/type fields are the supported client contract.

options.title: Split Runtime I18n Scope
options.body: Land narrower channel/runtime chat-copy localization first and defer gateway JSON localization to a separate contract discussion.

recommendation.title: Keep Protocol Text Stable
recommendation.body: Preserve stable gateway JSON message/reason strings and localize only clearly user-display chat/runtime copy unless a separate display field exists.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged the prior i18n work and recently touched the current i18n baseline, making them the best available routing candidate for the contract choice.
